title: noc_panel_rows undercounts drawn rows by 3 (always) — max scroll can never reach the panel's last rows (drop log)
evidence: measure (383-386): `noc_panel_rows :: proc(...) -> i32 {` / `	rows := i32(2) // header: title + global line` / `	rows += 2      // drops` / `	rows += 2      // crisis root causes` — but draw_noc_panel emits THREE header rows (442 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "DEBUG OVERLAY (D)", NOC_INK)`, 444 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, glob, NOC_INK_DIM)`, 446 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, hash, NOC_INK_SOFT)`), THREE drops rows (454 "DROPS since start...", 456 drops_line, 459 ratio_line), THREE crisis rows (462 "CRISIS root causes", 465/467 sat line, 470 pool_line). Also unmeasured: 597 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "(no events yet - draw pipes, deliver packets)", NOC_INK_SOFT)` and 608 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "(no drops yet)", NOC_INK_SOFT)`; and the measure's `if sel_pipe >= 0 { rows += 4 }` vs draw's conditional 0/1/4 (pipe_slot may fail, stats row may be absent).
detail: The scroll clamp `scroll := clamp(scroll_in, 0, max(0, total - visible))` uses the undercount, so the last ~3 rows (bottom of the drop log) are unreachable at max scroll — violating the proc's own 'MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row' contract.
recommended_fix: Count the hash line, ratio line, crisis header/pool line, and both empty-state placeholders in noc_panel_rows; make the sel-readout rows conditional on pipe_slot+stats-row presence, matching draw exactly.

title: main.odin draw-gate comment says 'F-key debug surface' but the shipped toggle is D
evidence: app/main.odin:588: `// v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws` — while app/input/poll.odin:51 gates `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.D) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .D})) }`, the e2e injects `Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .D})`, and the panel title is `"DEBUG OVERLAY (D)"`.
detail: The final user ruling dropped F ('one key, one panel' — D only); this leftover F reference in the shipped draw-gate comment contradicts the code and misleads maintainers.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to 'the D-key debug surface'.

title: New spec artifact still tells the implementer to inject Key_Press{.F} and verify 'F toggles the panel' after the D-only ruling
evidence: line 72: `... e2e auto-drive (PP_NOC_E2E=1: inject Key_Press{.F} after the polls at frame N, TakeScreenshot on/off, exit)` and line 109: `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin -- expected: compiles; F toggles the panel` — while the same file's Spec Change Log rules: `the D KEY stays as the toggle ... F is dropped (fallback only ...)`. The shipped code correctly injects .D.
detail: The Tasks and Verification sections of the new spec contradict its own final ruling and the code; a maintainer re-running the documented verification would test a key that does nothing.
recommended_fix: Update the two stale F references in the spec's Tasks/Verification sections to D (change-log entries already record the ruling).
